ratings.reason: Curation of scientific designs via multi-fidelity expert pairwise rankings, explicitly including agentic workflows as an expertise source, targets the candidate-selection bottleneck of automated scientific discovery.

Continuous process-level evaluation finds 92.6% of final-check-passing enterprise agent-skill runs contained evaluator-detected trajectory deviations, directly targeting behavioral-drift detection in evolving agent skills.

Maps the trust boundary of judgment models (Jev) as agent action selectors: 99% on counterintuitive Cognitive Reflection Test items when evaluation suffices, but systematic failure when choosing requires simulating unobserved dynamics.
VeriSpec audits the OpenAI Model Spec text itself for inconsistent principle pairs via LLM-as-verifier reasoning — spec-quality tooling for alignment, adjacent to but outside the listed areas.

Multi-view SAE alignment using pitch transposition as an inductive bias recovers structured concept orbits (chord and key transpositions) in a music foundation model's representations, moving beyond isolated feature identification.

ZTA-Q's configurable post-processing datapath quantifies how circuit-level approximations — reduced multiplier precision, shared shift scaling, simplified rounding — degrade INT8 CNN accuracy, bounding degradation within 0.25 points.
iMRAG is a black-box data-extraction attack steering queries through multimodal RAG embedding space to recover stored images — a privacy attack unrelated to any listed area.

TRACE's agentic heuristic design mines massive, noisy system logs so LLM agents can automatically synthesize auditable resource-assignment rules, extending automatic heuristic design beyond fully specified combinatorial problems.

Variable-precision study of stochastic rounding proves SR's O(sqrt(n)*u) versus RN's O(n*u) forward-error bounds for linear projections and decomposes expected cross-entropy drift into signed drift, curvature, and Fisher-weighted variance terms.
Derives a convergence bound for asynchronous GRPO under stale rollouts and proposes group mass capping (GMC-GRPO), improving the delay-term threshold dependence from O(eps^-4) to O(eps^-2).
EBFKC corrects imperfect pretrained diffusion models on the fly via Feynman-Kac dynamics with sequential Monte Carlo — correction of model approximation error, not numerical or hardware reliability.

Trains an agentic forecaster that acquires its own evidence (web search, page reading, leak-filtered financial series) at rollout time via GRPO under a Brier-score reward, improving calibration 30-40% while cutting search attempts.

FastCI uses runtime evidence to select, prune, and prioritize GPU tests for LLM training frameworks, cutting CI latency 77.5% — a CI-efficiency contribution with only secondary failure-exposure benefits.
Proves interactive arguments for oracle-aided AI oversight cannot generally be zero knowledge — oversight/privacy theory outside the listed areas.

Mingbird's ten harness mechanisms (byte-level net-zero prefill budget, finish gate that re-reads the task, signature-level loop detection) compensate documented small-model agent failure forms on real local tasks.
Mem++ shifts agent memory from write-time distillation to read-time selection with date and author provenance — a memory-architecture contribution without self-evolution or reliability analysis.

BDA models typed multi-LLM council moves (propose/challenge/concede) as annotator observations to infer per-agent reliability under persistent adversaries, yielding calibrated posterior correctness estimates.

Proves RLVR optimization pressure permits unbounded language drift while SFT does not, and that constraining drift necessarily constrains expected reward — a behavioral CoT pathology, not numerical instability or monitoring.

Controlled study of LLM novelty judges for automated ideation shows minor prompt changes flip verdicts on identical idea pairs, shifting pairwise accuracy by over 50 points — reliability of automated research evaluation.

Formalizes the multi-agent global coherence problem with an Observation-Aliasing Impossibility Theorem (worst-case randomized success 1/k) and sheaf-based local-to-global runtime semantics where the harness owns shared state.

Mimir couples LLM proposals to deterministic simulator checks and consolidates recurrent failure patterns into persistent contextual principles for season-long irrigation control without rewriting the safety-critical physics model.

CARM shows the geometric-mean masking rule's signed log-ratios cancel across positions, concealing substantial bidirectional off-policy drift, and proves a joint deviation bound for its absolute-value mask.

Layer-wise hidden-state probing localizes exact hallucination onset and continuation tokens, and a cross-model framework shows an external observer reading another model's activations matches or exceeds self-detection.

CMP restores identifiability of agent-memory utility by intervening on retrieval with known propensities and self-normalized inverse propensity weighting — causal methodology peripheral to the listed areas.

Shows intervention-defined faithfulness misranks circuits (KL misranks 9.4-41.2% of candidate pairs across EAP, EAP-IG, ACDC, and Edge-SP), exposing an objective-level recovery gap at the core of mechanistic interpretability.
Argo-Bench evaluates data agents on a simulated 235-table, 7.5-billion-row enterprise warehouse with withheld ground truth — a domain benchmark without ties to the listed areas.
Documents keyword-harness false positives in small-model tool-use claims and localizes one model's failure to an erased first-token tool-call prior (probability 1e-4 to 1e-5) via a probe.
Underdamped Langevin sampling theory with non-quadratic kinetic energies for non-convex, non-Lipschitz Gibbs potentials — numerical analysis disconnected from the listed areas.

RL-SAE post-training rewards generated protein sequences that activate specified SAE feature sets (90% of 30 targeted features vs 24% for activation steering) — SAEs used as RL reward inside a protein-design paper.
ZFO decouples direction selection from step-size, building a curvature-aware local model from two extra function evaluations — optimization efficiency without reliability content.

InterEvolve's LLM agent rewrites staged reward programs in context using execution feedback and retained learnings, achieving test-time task acquisition for humanoid loco-manipulation without retraining.
